run_musicgen_style_gradio_app: run the MusicGen-Style Gradio UI app with optional auth, port, and share flags
run_predict_full_music_generation: run music generation from text and optional melody using the predict_full function
run_do_predictions_batch: run batch audio predictions with text descriptions and melody conditioning via _do_predictions
load_musicgen_model: load a pretrained MusicGen model by version name using load_model
load_multiband_diffusion: load the MultiBandDiffusion model for enhanced audio decoding using load_diffusion
